reviewer: Independent /root/package_verification review of completed retained source/raw/restored output bytes; no model or translation calls.
decision: Reject this exact compact empty-tag profile for translation fidelity: one material actor/anaphora failure remains despite successful exact name restoration.

rubric.acceptable: Source meaning and required facts preserved without a notable defect.
rubric.minor_error: Recoverable wording, fluency or agreement defect without a material change to a fact, proposition, actor identity/relationship, amount, scope, condition or completeness.
rubric.major_error: Material omission, invention or change to an actor/anaphora, fact, role, amount, negation scope, condition, chronology or completeness.
rubric.source_script_names: Allowed before output inspection; ordinary surrounding prose still must be translated.

resources.measurement_limit: Sequential scans at 0.1-second intervals can miss transient peaks.

cases.summary: The saved transcript, unsaved original recording, twelve-minute transcription and not-yet-started Greek translation are all preserved.

criteria_judgments.evidence: μεταγραφή as a text file and αρχική ηχογράφηση remain distinct; the next sentence uses μεταγραφή for the transcription process in context.
αποθήκευσε ... αρχείο κειμένου; δεν αποθήκευσε ... αρχική ηχογράφηση.
Η μεταγραφή διήρκεσε 12 λεπτά; Η μετάφραση στα ελληνικά δεν έχει ξεκινήσει ακόμη.
Maria remains in Latin letters, expressly allowed. The Greek article Η is present.

source_segments.text: Maria saved the transcript as a text file; she did not save the original recording.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

source_segments.text: Transcription took 12 minutes. Translation into Greek has not started yet.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

unchanged_original_review_criteria: Distinguish the transcript text, the transcription process and the original audio recording.
Preserve that the text was saved but the original recording was not.
Preserve that transcription is complete and translation has not started, rather than claiming that translation took 12 minutes.
Maria may remain in Latin letters or be rendered naturally as Μαρία.

cases.summary: Exact source names, recipient negation and all three roles survive; two English articles are unnatural.

criteria_judgments.evidence: Ελένη is translator; Νίκος does recording; Έλενα checks subtitles. Ελένη and Έλενα remain distinct.
Νίκος sent the text to Ελένη, not to Έλενα.
The Νίκος and The Ελένη add the expressly prohibited unnatural English article.
Exact Greek source-script names are retained instead of transliteration; this was allowed before candidate generation. All surrounding ordinary prose is English.

errors.explanation: Recoverable fluency defect; no role, recipient or identity is changed.

cases.indicator_caveat: Latin-name term checks and Greek-letter counts do not independently establish an error when only exact protected source names retain Greek script.

unchanged_original_review_criteria: Keep Eleni and Elena as two distinct people and assign each the correct role.
Nikos sent the text to Eleni; Elena was not the recipient.
Do not add an unnatural English article before a person's name.
Reasonable transliteration variants are acceptable if the people remain consistently distinguishable.

cases.summary: All quantities, units, negation and the distinction between the receipt/slip and separate transfer are preserved.

criteria_judgments.evidence: €12.50 for 2 items; separate transfer 5.000 sats, not 500 sats.
5.000 is the valid Greek thousands rendering of 5,000; €12.50 retains the exact decimal value.
Το απόκομμα is understandable as the receipt/slip in this purchase context; Η ξεχωριστή μεταφορά keeps the transfer separate. The note does not say euros and sats are the same unit.
All ordinary prose is Greek; Bitcoin and sats remain technical notation as allowed.

cases.indicator_caveat: The literal 5,000-not-observed indicator is only localization here, not numerical corruption.

source_segments.text: The receipt shows €12.50 for 2 items. The separate transfer is 5,000 sats, not 500 sats.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

source_segments.text: The note mentions Bitcoin. It does not say that euros and sats are the same unit.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

unchanged_original_review_criteria: Preserve the values 12.50 euros, 2 items, 5000 sats and the explicitly rejected amount of 500 sats.
Locale-appropriate rendering such as 12,50 and 5.000 is valid if the numerical values are unchanged; literal-number flags alone are not errors.
Keep the receipt and transfer separate and retain the statement that euros and sats are different units.
Translate the ordinary English prose into Greek while allowing Bitcoin, sats and displayed receipt labels to remain as technical notation.
raw_masked_translation_strings: Το απόκομμα δείχνει €12.50 για 2 είδη. Η ξεχωριστή μεταφορά είναι 5.000 sats, όχι 500 sats.
Η σημείωση αναφέρει Bitcoin. Δεν λέει ότι τα ευρώ και τα sats είναι η ίδια μονάδα.
restored_translation_strings: Το απόκομμα δείχνει €12.50 για 2 είδη. Η ξεχωριστή μεταφορά είναι 5.000 sats, όχι 500 sats.
Η σημείωση αναφέρει Bitcoin. Δεν λέει ότι τα ευρώ και τα sats είναι η ίδια μονάδα.

cases.summary: The two negation scopes and temporal/modal facts survive, but both later propositions introduce masculine he where the Greek source continues the explicitly feminine Άννα.

criteria_judgments.evidence: The denial of having said sold all and the assertion of no sales yesterday retain their logical scopes, but the latter is attributed to he rather than the source’s η Άννα.
didn't sell any is retained; it is not weakened to didn't sell all.
Today ... might sell one and hasn't been decided yet preserve possibility and undecided status, but the subject is again he.
Full propositions were reviewed: the problem is actor/anaphora fidelity, not a missing not or a reversed negation.

source_quotes: Είπα ότι δεν πούλησε κανένα χθες.
output_quotes: I said that he didn't sell any yesterday.
errors.explanation: The source explicitly names the feminine η Άννα and continues that subject. The translation changes both references to masculine he, introducing a different or inconsistent referent. Exact spelling restoration of Άννα does not repair these propositions.

successful_content: Denial of saying sold all remains a denial of that reported claim.
No sales yesterday is preserved as none/any, not merely not all.
The possible sale is one book and remains undecided.
cases.severity_distinction: Unlike the English-source Giannis case, the source itself explicitly supplies the feminine article and continuing subject; the output uses stand-alone pronouns for the later propositions.

source_segments.text: Δεν είπα ότι η Άννα πούλησε όλα τα βιβλία. Είπα ότι δεν πούλησε κανένα χθες.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 3

source_segments.text: Σήμερα μπορεί να πουλήσει ένα, αλλά αυτό δεν έχει αποφασιστεί.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 3

unchanged_original_review_criteria: Preserve both scopes: denial of having said 'sold all', and the positive report that she sold none yesterday.
Do not turn 'did not sell any' into 'did not sell all', which allows some sales.
Today's possible sale remains undecided rather than certain or completed.
Judge complete propositions; merely retaining a token such as 'not' does not establish correct negation.
raw_masked_translation_strings: I didn't say that <x0/> sold all the books. I said that he didn't sell any yesterday.
Today he might sell one, but this hasn't been decided yet.
restored_translation_strings: I didn't say that Άννα sold all the books. I said that he didn't sell any yesterday.
Today he might sell one, but this hasn't been decided yet.

cases.summary: Actors, necessary approval condition, nonresponse condition and both dates remain correct; η Giannis is an unnatural Greek gender agreement.

criteria_judgments.evidence: Anna publishes, Giannis approves. Neither role is swapped.
μόνο αν preserves approval as necessary.
Αν η Giannis δεν απαντήσει explicitly keeps Giannis as the person who may fail to answer.
μέχρι την Παρασκευή and μέχρι τη Δευτέρα preserve Friday and Monday.

errors.explanation: The feminine article before the masculine name is a Greek agreement defect. The source has no explicit gendered pronoun; the exact name remains attached to the correct action in both clauses, so this is not classified as a changed actor or role.

source_segments.text: Anna will publish the video only if Giannis approves the text.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

source_segments.text: If Giannis does not answer by Friday, Anna will wait until Monday.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

unchanged_original_review_criteria: Giannis approves and Anna publishes; do not reverse their roles.
Approval is a necessary condition: retain 'only if', not merely a possible reason for publication.
The no-answer condition concerns Giannis, not Anna.
Retain Friday as the response deadline and Monday as the end of the waiting period.
raw_masked_translation_strings: Η <x0/> θα δημοσιεύσει το βίντεο μόνο αν η <x1/> εγκρίνει το κείμενο.
Αν η <x2/> δεν απαντήσει μέχρι την Παρασκευή, η <x3/> θα περιμένει μέχρι τη Δευτέρα.
restored_translation_strings: Η Anna θα δημοσιεύσει το βίντεο μόνο αν η Giannis εγκρίνει το κείμενο.
Αν η Giannis δεν απαντήσει μέχρι την Παρασκευή, η Anna θα περιμένει μέχρι τη Δευτέρα.

cases.summary: The quoted question, both alternatives, lack of an answer and insufficient title evidence survive; Person is an unnecessary label before Μαρία.

criteria_judgments.evidence: Does the file have 12 chapters or 21? remains a quoted question with both alternatives.
We still do not know the answer; The title alone is not enough to confirm it.
No count is chosen, and no answer is invented.

errors.explanation: Person is an unnatural, unsupported label in the prose. It does not substitute a different person or change the question; classify as a minor wording addition.

cases.indicator_caveat: The missing Latin Maria term is not itself an error because exact source-script Μαρία was preauthorized.

source_segments.text: Η Μαρία ρώτησε: «Το αρχείο έχει 12 κεφάλαια ή 21;»
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 2

source_segments.text: Δεν γνωρίζουμε ακόμη την απάντηση. Ο τίτλος μόνος του δεν αρκεί για να το διαπιστώσουμε.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 2

unchanged_original_review_criteria: Keep the first sentence as a quoted question with two alternatives; do not choose a count.
Retain the explicit uncertainty and the insufficiency of the title as evidence.
Do not invent an answer or convert the question into a factual statement.
raw_masked_translation_strings: Person <x0/> asked: 'Does the file have 12 chapters or 21?'
We still do not know the answer. The title alone is not enough to confirm it.
restored_translation_strings: Person Μαρία asked: 'Does the file have 12 chapters or 21?'
We still do not know the answer. The title alone is not enough to confirm it.

scope_limits: All six are already-exposed short development cases, not fresh validation.
Exact restored source names do not certify ordinary prose, grammatical gender, pronouns, within-segment roles or completeness.
The separate frozen detector and boundary-normalizer limitations remain; no baseline rejection is regraded.
No unused v3, broader corpus, summary, full-app or production-model approval follows.
Resource measurements cover this isolated stage with retained sequential samples; unobserved transient peaks and full-app coexistence remain outside this measurement.
A later proposed marker profile is a separate candidate; this rejection remains immutable.
